Software Engineer — Backend

We're hiring backend engineers to work on our core API platform.

Requirements:
- 2+ years of backend experience in Python or Go
- Strong SQL and relational database skills
- You must have experience with distributed systems at scale
- Comfortable writing production-grade code

Nice to have:
- Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming
- Familiarity with Kubernetes

We offer competitive compensation. Our benefits include health,
dental, vision, 401k matching, and unlimited PTO. If you are
interested, please submit your resume and a short cover letter
describing why you want to join.
